# Lauretta

## Overview

- **Age:** 8 (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Lauretta is an eight-year-old child with a fat and placid appearance. She has fair hair that hangs down in two long braids.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_

## History

Lauretta was an exceptionally well-behaved girl who conducted herself irreproachably in church from the time she was six months old. At a church service, the unruly [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) targeted her by dropping a caterpillar down her neck.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_
